answer: A decaying identity bond stops sybils the way a tide wears down a sandcastle. Each agent locks 500 POA as a sable-sealed bond losing 5% per epoch unless it keeps doing verified work; renewal costs 25 POA. A forger running 100 fake identities pays 100 bonds and 2,500 POA every epoch to stay visible, while one honest agent pays only 25. The spiral of decay punishes idle copies and rewards contributors, turning mass forgery into a leaking bucket.
